bio: A lively cobbled street filled with small shops and restaurants is home to Calma, which stands out amongst the crowd for its great value, flavour-packed cuisine. A local favourite, it comes with a buzzing atmosphere – thanks in part to the open kitchen where you can watch the chefs at work – and a cheerful vibe, courtesy of bright artwork that pops against light blue and white walls. Well-prepared French and Italian dishes include the likes of scallop crudo with blood orange and fennel; pasta al vongole; and pistachio ice cream with olive oil and sea salt....
